name: sage
description: AI skills framework: UNDERSTAND → ENVISION → DELIVER → REFLECT. Process enforcement, 14 workflows, 37 skills, 5 agent personas. Single Hermes plugin with auto-discovered skills + slash commands for the 16 workflow entry points.

author.name: Rei Stewart (adapted from xoai/sage claude-code plugin)

platform_compat_notes: Hermes reads plugin.yaml (this file's sibling) directly; marketplace.json is for cross-platform installation via the claude-code marketplace. On Hermes, the plugin ships as a single directory at ~/.hermes/plugins/sage/.
